# tools/requirements.txt
#
# The Python dependencies of the tree checks, pinned by version AND by
# content hash.
#
# CI previously ran `pip install jsonschema cryptography pyyaml` with no
# pins at all, in a repository whose whole premise is that frozen vectors
# and schema verdicts are reproducible. A guard that recomputes a golden
# value is only as trustworthy as the library that recomputed it, and an
# unpinned install means the verdict could change between two runs of the
# same commit without anything in the tree moving.
#
# Every transitive dependency is listed, because `--require-hashes`
# refuses a partial set — which is the point: an unlisted package is one
# nobody chose.
#
# Every published sha256 for each version is listed rather than the one
# wheel this platform resolves, so the file stays correct across the
# runner architectures CI may use.
#
# To update: change the version, then re-list its hashes from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json. Never widen a pin to make
# an install succeed; work out what moved first.

attrs==26.1.0 \
    --hash=sha256:c647aa4a12dfbad9333ca4e71fe62ddc36f4e63b2d260a37a8b83d2f043ac309 \
    --hash=sha256:d03ceb89cb322a8fd706d4fb91940737b6642aa36998fe130a9bc96c985eff32
# brotli: for the decoder verify_fixture_vectors.py gains in Stage 14 batch 3,
# for the brotli-compressed human-chat-v2 vectors (plan §17). Nothing imports
# it before that commit; it is installed ahead so that commit needs no CI
# change. No dependencies.
